anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the merge-sha substitutes to 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978 inside the quoted comment, the reused worktree is force-removed and csv-export deleted with -D, the close command passes '210' (hash stripped) and the comment as separate arguments, and the first menu is the closed-PR cleanup/stop template with no coverage rows and show evidence demoted to the hint line, with the landed-change guard evaluated before each override. Note that f4 already held in Before's text (its overlay menu was also cleanup/stop with guards), so the expected fails->holds move for this case is not visible in the outputs; the real deltas are template wording ('Pick one:', 'Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.') and the dropped '-R acme/widgets' flag, which After correctly omits since the override command is run verbatim. One small risk in After: 'base: synced 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978' asserts that main's post-pull HEAD is exactly the merge commit rather than merely containing it; Before's '<HEAD sha after pull, contains ...>' is safer. Keep the shared menus.md rows and hint placement as written, but have the base line report the actual pulled HEAD (or a placeholder) and state that it contains the merge commit, rather than equating the two.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves f4 as intended: the first menu is now exactly cleanup=1 / stop=2 with show evidence demoted to the hint line, no own-merge coverage rows appear, and the numeric cleanup pick runs the landed guards (merge-base --is-ancestor on the merge SHA plus a gh pr view refresh before the external write). The post-cleanup menu correctly drops the cleanup row and keeps show evidence as a hint; consider stating that the primary checkout now contains the merge commit so the 'leaving the primary checkout on main' stop row reads as a verified state rather than an assumption.
